title: Reminder rows drive due-soon only; compliance has none
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A schedule open in the editor with a service form ready. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Settings > Maintenance > New schedule (or open a schedule and Edit).
  4. ↳ Click Add service to open the service form.
  5. A routine service with reminder rows, and a compliance service, both available to inspect.
custom_steps:
1. Check what the reminder rows affect on the asset tab, the worklist and the panel.
  2. Look for any send switch on the schedule or service.
  3. Open a compliance service form and look for reminder rows.
  4. Note the effect of rows dated after the due date.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The rows drive when a service reads "due soon" on the asset tab, the worklist and the panel; they do not decide whether a row is listed on the worklist (S13 does), and in this release they email nobody.
  • Nothing in this release emails a customer automatically - there is no send switch on the schedule or a service; reminders are not labelled internal-only.
  • A compliance service has no reminder rows; its form shows "Remind before expiry" in their place.
  • Rows after the due date carry no internal effect this release (a service is overdue from its due date onward whatever they say); they are kept because the email chunk sends on them.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10562 (S5, Reminder timing); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S5; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R8: “The rows drive when a service reads due soon on the asset tab, the worklist and the panel. They do not decide whether a row is listed on the worklist, which S13 does. In this release they email nobody”
  • S5-R11: “A compliance service has no reminder rows. Its form shows Remind before expiry, per S3-R8, in their place”
  • S5-N1: “Nothing in this release emails a customer automatically. There is no send switch on the schedule or on a service ... Reminders are not labelled internal-only”
  • S5-E1: “Rows after the due date carry no internal effect in this release: a service is overdue from its due date onward whatever they say. They are kept because the email chunk sends on them”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build (feature ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag)
